OSMS 0.9.2 is a maintainer draft. The maintainer may correct and publish 0.x
versions before the Review Board starts.

- All 327 cards have additional calculation profiles across the retained eight
  dialects: 207 canonical quotients, 119 prepared-observation profiles and SOC-003.
- Typed inputs and named outputs include units, tolerances, identity, version,
  period, completeness and invalid-state rules. Excel templates include capacity
  guards; exact ES|QL distribution profiles use a declared export/reducer protocol.
- 125 changed card definitions use version 0.9.2; 201 retain 0.9.1 and one 0.9.0.
  All 327 cards retain all 48 source fields, including draft lifecycle.
- Duration, normalization, DSPS, confidence, penalties, ranking, multi-output,
  survey and risk mechanics have independent examples and negative cases.
- Historical evaluation archives detect changed or missing evidence; releases
  require successful checks and matching execution evidence for their own commit.
- Framework associations are explicitly not assessed until an edition, rationale
  and actual review record exist. Website integration is handled externally.

Generation is separate from native engine verification and source-adapter
validation. Synthetic benchmarks are not pilot evidence. Actual engine results,
remaining issue criteria and migration details are recorded in
review/EXECUTION_VALIDATION.md, review/RELEASE_0.9.2.md and GitHub issues.
This draft makes no Board approval or ISO conformity claim.

Verify the downloaded ZIP with SHA256SUMS.txt. MANIFEST-SHA256.txt covers every
